annotations.title: Probe Stream Record Availability & Freshness

cleanProvenanceBadge: 100% First-Party & Open Government Licensed (commercial_resell_ok — Zero ToS-violating portal scraping)
description: Free ($0, no auth), read-only, idempotent pre-check of record existence and 24h freshness across 16 streams. Pass streamId with corporateNumber, domain, lei, or boardSlug (default streamId="domain-intel", limit=25); returns stock status ordered by target match. Note: For stream schemas, use list_data_streams instead.

amendmentsOnly.description: When true in mode="edinet_gc_amendments", probes amended securities/quarterly/semi-annual reports.

assetSymbol.description: Optional digital currency ticker filter in mode="ofac_sanctions" across 600 organization-linked SDN wallets (e.g. "TRX", "ETH", "XBT", "USDT"). Free probes return dataset availability only.

ats.description: ATS platform when probing ats-jobs ("greenhouse", "lever", or "ashby").

boardSlug.description: Company ATS board slug when probing ats-jobs (e.g. "stripe", "layerx").

companyScale.description: Company scale ("large", "sme", "micro", or "other") when probing mode="gov_qualification".

corporateNumber.description: 13-digit Japanese Corporate Number (NTA Mod-9 validated, e.g. "1180301018771") when probing corporate registry, recalls, or tenders.

corporateNumbers.description: Batch of 1 to 25 13-digit Japanese Corporate Numbers for free stock probing.

cveId.description: CVE identifier (e.g. "CVE-2024-0001") when probing cyber advisories.

docId.description: 8-character EDINET filing document ID (e.g. "S100ABCD") when probing mode="edinet_gc_amendments".

domain.description: Domain name to check when probing domain posture or corporate registry (e.g. "nttdata.com", "preferred.jp").

domains.description: Batch of 1 to 25 corporate domains when probing domain posture or corporate registry.

edinetCode.description: 6-character FSA EDINET submitter code (e.g. "E02144") when probing mode="edinet_gc_amendments" or securities filings.

entityName.description: Organization or corporate legal name when probing mode="ofac_sanctions".

entityNames.description: Batch of 1 to 25 organization or corporate legal names when probing mode="ofac_sanctions".

excludeGoingConcern.description: In mode="screen" / "filter", excludes corporations with active EDINET Going Concern notes or material events.

excludeLapsedLei.description: In mode="screen" / "filter", excludes corporations whose GLEIF LEI status is LAPSED.

excludeRecentEdinetAmendments.description: In mode="screen" / "filter", excludes corporations that filed recent amended securities reports on EDINET.

geo.description: 2-letter ISO country code when probing google-trends (e.g. "US", "JP").

goingConcernOnly.description: When true in mode="edinet_gc_amendments", probes filings with statutory Going Concern notes or material events.

hasBicOnly.description: When true in mode="gleif_lei", filters for entities with SWIFT BIC codes.

holeNumber.description: Optional golf hole number (1-18) when probing ansr-golf-ev-engine.

includeWeakAliases.description: Optional flag for paid OFAC screening (weak AKAs excluded by default unless true; when true, weak AKAs are tagged with matchedVia="weak_aka_alias" and akaStrength="weak"). Free probes return dataset availability only.

keyword.description: Search keyword when probing search trends or Japanese public data streams.

lapsedOnly.description: When true in mode="gleif_lei", filters for LAPSED LEI registrations.

lei.description: 20-character ISO 17442 LEI (Mod 97-10 validated, e.g. "5493006W3QUS5LMH6R84") when probing mode="gleif_lei".

leis.description: Batch of 1 to 25 20-character ISO 17442 LEI codes.

limit.description: Optional row scan limit (1 to 25, default 25; free probes cap internal scan budget at 25 rows).

minQualificationGrade.description: Minimum Unified Government Qualification grade ("A" highest through "D").

mode.description: Mode when probing jp-entity-reputation ("lookup", "batch", "screen", "filter", "gleif_lei", "ofac_sanctions", "gov_qualification", or "edinet_gc_amendments") or ansr-golf-ev-engine ("ev", "sg", "dispersion", "strategy", "course_search", or "hole_strategy").

prefecture.description: Japanese prefecture name or 2-digit JIS code across all 47 prefectures (e.g. "北海道", "東京都", "大阪府", "13").

prefectureCode.description: 2-digit JIS prefecture code across all 47 Japanese prefectures ("01" to "47", e.g. "13" for Tokyo, "27" for Osaka).

qualificationGrade.description: Exact Unified Government Qualification grade ("A", "B", "C", or "D") when probing mode="gov_qualification".

query.description: Facility/station/golf-course query string when probing spatial or ANSR golf streams.

requireGleifLei.description: In mode="screen" / "filter", requires the corporation to hold a registered GLEIF LEI.

secCode.description: 4- or 5-digit Japanese securities code when probing securities filings or mode="edinet_gc_amendments".

streamId.description: Target B2A stream identifier from the 16-stream enum to pre-check record availability and 24h freshness.

strictExcludeUnobserved.description: In mode="screen" / "filter", controls unknown/unobserved handling for exclusion filters (excludeGoingConcern, excludeRecentEdinetAmendments, excludeLapsedLei). Defaults to false (retains unobserved corporations with unobservedOrExcludedScopes[] tags; when true, unobserved corporations are also excluded).

subLayer.description: Optional specialized hard-fact sub-layer ledger name (e.g. "jp18_and_nutrient_standards", "meti_manufacturing_champions", "meti_cscl_chemical_registry", "eu_cosing_jp_bridge", "mhlw_jsqi_2021_index", "foshu_tokuho_claims", "functional_food_claims", "mhlw_cosmetic_standards", "approved_food_additives", "kobutsu_url_ledger", "keishin_financials", "harvest_labor_violations", "facility_brand_operator_links", "mlit_negative_dispositions", "product_compliance_checkpoint").

walletAddress.description: Blockchain wallet address (e.g. "0x...", "TNiq9AXBp9EjUqhDhrwrfvAA8U3GUQZH81") when probing mode="ofac_sanctions".

walletAddresses.description: Batch of 1 to 25 blockchain wallet addresses for OFAC dataset availability probing.

name: probe_stream_inventory

currentHash.description: 64-character hex SHA-256 content digest when recordExists is true, or null when not in stock.

freshWithin24h.description: True when the target observation or dataset snapshot was verified within the past 24 hours.

matchedCount.description: Matched record count in the bounded probe window (null when redacted for paid OFAC screening).

ok.description: True when the free 1st-floor inventory probe completed without error.

paidEndpoint.description: Ready-to-call x402 HTTP endpoint URL pre-populated with the probed query parameters.

probedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when this free probe was executed.

recordExists.description: True when matching structured records or dataset snapshots are currently in stock.

sealStatus.description: TAPP Sigstore Rekor cryptographic Merkle seal status of the probed dataset.

streamId.description: Resolved B2A data stream identifier that was probed.

targetKey.description: Normalized deterministic ledger target key inspected for availability.

x402PriceUsd.description: Base Mainnet USDC price for instant x402 pay-per-request execution (e.g. "$0.006").
